description:
This series is exposing the history, issues, traps, tricks, and the truth about spiritual formation and what God's people can do about it.

“Take no part in the unfruitful works of darkness, but instead expose them” (Eph 5:11, ESV).

“The enemy of souls has sought to bring in the supposition that a great reformation was to take place among Seventh-day Adventists... and... would consist in giving up the doctrines... of our faith” (Selected Messages, Vol. 1, p. 205).
